guard: a post-join notice refused because the resumed session is mid-turn is recorded and swallowed, so the seat that already joined survives it
why: The refusal used to reach the startup catch and kill an already-joined seat, discarding the session being recovered. Rethrowing from the notice own catch restores that path. The named cell is the functional one: the join and the notice frame both precede the send, so those cells pass in BOTH directions, and the first guarantee that actually breaks is the seat continuing to do mesh work afterwards.

mutations.name: the refused post-join notice is fatal to the launch again
mutations.expectRed: a seat whose notice was refused still receives later mesh work as a real turn
mutations.cell: a seat whose notice was refused still receives later mesh work as a real turn
